message.content: Based on the discussion, Dyllan describes the combat in "Horizon Forbidden West" as being challenging due to the presence of flying machines. He mentions that dealing with these flying machines can be tricky and advises using a bow equipped with elemental arrows to stun them and then taking them down more easily. Additionally, Dyllan suggests utilizing the game's focus system to track the movements of the flying machines, which helps in dodging their attacks. He also recommends setting up traps as a game-changer, noting that it adds a strategic layer to the battles.
